This Epic covers user account management and authentication functionality for the ShopEasy online shopping application.

The functionality includes:

* User registration with valid and unique email addresses.
* User login and authentication.
* Account locking after five consecutive failed login attempts for 15 minutes.
* Password recovery through a time-limited, single-use reset link.
* Secure logout and prevention of access to authenticated pages after logout.

Requirements covered: REQ-A1, REQ-A2, REQ-A3, REQ-A4, REQ-A5.

This Epic covers the product discovery and browsing functionality of the ShopEasy online shopping application.

The functionality includes:

* Displaying products with pagination.
* Searching products by name using case-insensitive keywords.
* Filtering products by category and price range.
* Sorting products by price and name.
* Viewing product details, stock status and Add to Cart availability.

Requirements covered: REQ-B1, REQ-B2, REQ-B3, REQ-B4, REQ-B5.

This Epic covers shopping cart operations and the complete order placement process in the ShopEasy online shopping application.

The functionality includes:

* Displaying the total number of cart items.
* Updating product quantities and removing cart items.
* Applying eligible discount coupons.
* Validating checkout and shipping information.
* Supporting Card, UPI and Cash on Delivery payment methods.
* Displaying order confirmation with a unique Order ID and confirmation email.

Requirements covered: REQ-C1, REQ-C2, REQ-C3, REQ-C4, REQ-C5, REQ-C6.

REQ-A3

As a user,
I want my account to be locked after five consecutive failed login attempts
to prevent unauthorized access.

Acceptance Criteria:

# Given five consecutive failed attempts, 
When the fifth attempt fails, 
Then my account should be locked for 15 minutes.
# Given a locked account, 
When I try to log in before 15 minutes, 
Then access should be denied.

REQ-A1

As a new user, 

I want to register using my name, email and password,

so that I can create an account.

Acceptance Criteria:

# Given valid registration details, 
When I submit the form, 
Then my account should be created.
# Given an already registered email, 
When I register again, 
Then the system should reject it.

As a registered user,

I want to log in using my email and password,

So that i can access my account.

Acceptance Criteria:

# Given valid credentials, 
When I log in, 
Then I should reach the home page.
# Given invalid credentials, 
When I log in, 
Then I should see "Invalid email or password".

REQ-A4

As a user, I want to reset my forgotten password using an email link so that I can regain account access.

Acceptance Criteria:

# Given a registered email, 
When I request a reset, 
Then a reset link should be emailed.
# Given an expired or previously used link, 
When I open it, 
Then the reset should be rejected.

REQ-A5

As a logged-in user, 
I want to log out securely ,
so that my account cannot be accessed by others.

Acceptance Criteria:

# Given an authenticated session, 
When I log out, 
Then the session should end.
# Given that I have logged out, 
When I press the browser Back button, 
Then account pages should not be accessible.

REQ-B2
As a customer, 
I want to search products by name ,
so that I can quickly find items.

Acceptance Criteria:

# Given a matching product exists, 
When I search by keyword, 
Then matching products should appear regardless of letter case.
# Given no matching product exists, 
When I search, 
Then "No products found" should appear.

REQ-B1

As a customer, 
I want to view products in a paginated list, 
so that I can browse available items.

Acceptance Criteria:

# Given products are available, 
When I open the product page, 
Then 12 products should appear per page.
# Given products are displayed, 
When I view a product card, 
Then its image, name and price should appear.

column1: Update Quantity and Remove Cart Items
column29:
REQ-C2, REQ-C3

As a customer, I want to update quantities and remove products so that I can manage my cart.

Acceptance Criteria:

# Given an item is in my cart, When I change its quantity between 1 and 10, Then the line total should update.
# Given an item is in my cart, When I remove it, Then the cart total should update immediately.
# Given all items are removed, When I open my cart, Then an empty cart message should appear.

REQ-C6

As a customer, I want to select a payment method and receive order confirmation so that I know my order was placed.

Acceptance Criteria:

# Given I am checking out, When I select Card, UPI or COD and place the order, Then the order should be processed.
# Given my order is placed, When confirmation is displayed, Then I should receive a unique Order ID and confirmation email.

REQ-C5

As a customer, I want to provide valid shipping details and log in before checkout so that I can place an order.

Acceptance Criteria:

# Given I am not logged in, When I proceed to checkout, Then I should be required to log in.
# Given shipping details are incomplete or invalid, When I submit checkout, Then validation errors should appear.

REQ-B5

As a customer, I want to view product details and stock status so that I can decide whether to purchase a product.

Acceptance Criteria:

# Given a product is selected, When I open its details, Then its images, name, price, description and stock status should appear.
# Given a product is out of stock, When I view its details, Then Add to Cart should be disabled.

REQ-C4

As a customer, I want to apply a coupon so that I can receive eligible discounts.

Acceptance Criteria:

# Given my cart value is at least Rs.1000, When I apply SAVE10, Then a 10% discount should be applied.
# Given my cart value is below Rs.1000, When I apply SAVE10, Then the coupon should be rejected.

REQ-C1
As a customer, I want to see the total number of items in my cart so that I can track my selections.

Acceptance Criteria:

# Given I add products to my cart, When I view the cart icon, Then it should display the total item count.
# Given my cart is empty, When I view the cart icon, Then it should display zero items.
